sys_hub_action_type_definition.description: Calls bfd_ReroutingEngine.evaluateReroute(caseSysId): re-evaluates the active routing rules against the CURRENT risk/case_type/amount/channel and re-assigns the case when the owning team should change. Skips resolved/closed/pending_approval, leaves the owner alone when no rule matches, only escalates priority, and withholds the move (advisory note only) when an agent is explicitly assigned.
sys_hub_action_type_definition.name: bfd_action_reroute_on_risk
